alert_states_metric_matches_kind.name: alert_states_metric_matches_kind
alert_states_metric_matches_kind.value:
("alert_states"."kind" = 'threshold' and "alert_states"."metric" is not null)
        or ("alert_states"."kind" = 'audit_failure' and "alert_states"."metric" is null)

audit_logs_scores_range.name: audit_logs_scores_range
audit_logs_scores_range.value:
("audit_logs"."score_performance" is null or "audit_logs"."score_performance" between 0 and 100)
        and ("audit_logs"."score_seo" is null or "audit_logs"."score_seo" between 0 and 100)
        and ("audit_logs"."score_accessibility" is null or "audit_logs"."score_accessibility" between 0 and 100)
        and ("audit_logs"."score_best_practices" is null or "audit_logs"."score_best_practices" between 0 and 100)
